author: Quaero I
title: Simple 1D CNN for Sequence Modeling
abstract: A simple 1D Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture designed to capture local sequence motifs in RNA. This approach replaces the default MLP's sequence-agnostic pooling with convolutional layers to better model the input data structure.
